newsitem.title: USA: Wilmar Industries Inc to buy Pier Angeli.
newsitem.headline: Wilmar Industries Inc to buy Pier Angeli.

text.p: Wilmar Industries Inc said on Monday it signed a letter of intent to purchase for cash the assets of Pier Angeli Co.
Pier Angeli is a $10 million supplier of repair and maintenance products primarily to multi-unit apartment complexes in Eastern and Midwest markets.
The closing of the transaction is subject to satisfactory completion of due diligence by the company and the execution of a definitive purchase agreement.
Wilmar, down 1/8 at 22-5/8 minutes after midday trading, is a national marketer and direct distributor of repair and maintenance products, principally to the apartment housing market.
